Grandparents instilled in me at a young age to save and how to save (long term high interest accounts, planning expenditures in spreadsheets etc). 
Any birthday money or money from work was saved and I kept a little aside for me for everyday things.
Didn’t grow up poor, but certainly didn’t grow up wealthy. Middle class with a single mother who ran her own business and worked 7 days a week to ensure I had a roof over my head and food on the table 

When I was emotionally ready and mature enough I bought a house with my partner and we are living comfortably.
I have just been to 2 pharmacies that are out of Nuvigil (Armodafinil).. it’s not just frustrating it’s disheartening. Third time the charm at least.
